subject: English
passage: Wanting to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the United Nations founding, ______ up with a design that best represented the organization's global mission. The committee selected "Unity in Diversity," submitted by Geneva artist Marie Dubois, as its winning entry.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: the UN Cultural Heritage Board organized a competition that would award $500 to an individual who came
choices.B: a competition organized by the UN Cultural Heritage Board would award $500 to an individual who came
choices.C: an award of $500 would go to an individual in a competition organized by the UN Cultural Heritage Board for coming
choices.D: $500 would be awarded to an individual by the UN Cultural Heritage Board in a competition for coming

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-modifier placement. This choice makes the noun phrase "the UN Cultural Heritage Board" the subject of the sentence and places it immediately after the modifying phrase "wanting…founding." In doing so, this choice clearly establishes that the UN Cultural Heritage Board—and not another noun in the sentence—wanted to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the United Nations founding.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because it results in a dangling modifier. The placement of the noun phrase "an award of $500" immediately after the modifying phrase illogically suggests that the award of $500 wanted to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the United Nations founding.
